title: [google_sign_in] needs updating to support eMudhra
body:
### Steps to reproduce

According to the [documentation](https://firebase.google.com/support/guides/compromised-emudhra-intermediate-ca) we're encouraged to update Firestore, but if we move to something like 7.1.0 for `cloud_firestore`, then we can no longer use `google_sign_in: 7.2.0`, ultimately because of `gtm-session-fetcher`:

```

xcodebuild: error: Could not resolve package dependencies:
  Failed to resolve dependencies Dependencies could not be resolved because 'firebase_storage-14.0.1' depends on 'firebase-ios-sdk' 13.1.1 and 'google_sign_in_ios-6.3.6' depends on 'googlesignin-ios' 9.0.0..<10.0.0.
'googlesignin-ios' is incompatible with 'firebase-ios-sdk' because 'googlesignin-ios' 9.2.0 depends on 'gtm-session-fetcher' 3.3.0..<4.0.0 and 'firebase-ios-sdk' 13.1.1 depends on 'gtm-session-fetcher' 4.0.0..<6.0.0.
'googlesignin-ios' {9.0.0..<9.2.0, 9.2.1..<10.0.0} practically depends on 'gtm-session-fetcher' 3.3.0..<4.0.0 because 'googlesignin-ios' 9.1.0 depends on 'gtm-session-fetcher' 3.3.0..<4.0.0.
'googlesignin-ios' {9.0.0..<9.1.0, 9.1.1..<9.2.0, 9.2.1..<10.0.0} practically depends on 'gtm-session-fetcher' 3.3.0..<4.0.0 because no versions of 'googlesignin-ios' match the requirement {9.0.1..<9.1.0, 9.1.1..<9.2.0, 9.2.1..<10.0.0} and 'googlesignin-ios' 9.0.0 depends on 'gtm-session-fetcher' 3.3.0..<4.0.0.
```

### Expected results

Expect to be able to compile.

### Actual results

Cannot compile
